title: Integrate ORODI into the Craft Product construction chain
outcome: Establish six stable Craft Product Capability identities for operational resilience, bind their business ontology and DomainSpec v2 profile to explicit admission owners, and carry each capability through a Project-owned D65 ConstructionBinding without inflating implementation or runtime evidence.
rationale: ORODI already has source-bound business meaning, a deterministic DomainSpec graph, a candidate system ontology, one implemented contract vertical, and explicit residues. It needs Product and Project ownership so later implementation, conformance, and commissioning remain interpretable and owner-controlled.
scope: six CAV2-D67 Product Capability candidate records owned by CA2-PRODUCT-CRAFT
one business-system bridge ontology at domainspec.orodi.ontology@1
one ORODI DomainSpec v2 development profile, compiled graph, and candidate system ontology
separate business-ontology, profile, system-ontology, implementation, conformance, and runtime-evidence owner gates
exclusions: treating candidate Product Capability records as adopted
treating a named owner as an admission decision
registering a ConstructionBinding before every predecessor stage validates
claiming SWU-BWCR-002 through SWU-BWCR-010 are implemented
commissioning infrastructure, publishing, releasing, deploying, or creating external effects
owner_route: Craft Project owner plus Craft Product owner plus Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner plus DomainSpec v2 language and compiler owners

success_conditions.statement: The Craft Project references this Goal and all six ORODI ConstructionBindings.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Project and Goal schemas validate and references close bidirectionally.

success_conditions.statement: All six ORODI outcomes have stable CAV2-D67 Product Capability candidate identities and immutable record digests.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: The capability package validates the shared Product Capability shape and canonical record hashes.

success_conditions.statement: Business ontology and DomainSpec profile admission are decided by their named owners against immutable candidate digests.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Owner decisions name exact candidate paths and SHA-256 digests; changed bytes require successor decisions.

success_conditions.statement: Each capability crosses D65 to independently assessed static conformance and bounded runtime evidence.
success_conditions.evidence_requirement: Registered construction records contain validated predecessors, exact implementation targets, independent conformance, and capability-specific runtime evidence.

evidence_requirements: Product Capability adoption, business ontology admission, and DomainSpec profile admission remain separate digest-bound decisions.
Project ownership coordinates work but grants no implementation or effect authority.
Planned implementation files remain absent evidence rather than inferred implementation.
Commissioning requires a later exact effect authorization and complete teardown evidence.
target_horizon: owner-admitted ontology and profile before successor implementation

revision_history.change: Created the Project-owned ORODI integration Goal and kept adoption, admission, implementation, conformance, and commissioning as separate gates.

challenge_route: Challenge Product Capability meaning through the Craft Product owner, business ontology through the Craft ORODI Business Ontology owner, DomainSpec profile and graph through the DomainSpec v2 language and compiler owners, and runtime effects through the separately authorized ORODI commissioning owner.
